q2_gaps: a non-deictic, modifier-restricted season as a temporal frame ('throughout deep winter'): 'throughout' is mapped to During, whose outer argument is specified as a reified eventuality ('both reified'), while the Time section supplies structured terms only for Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic season constants ('last_spring') - so a bare season period has no licensed carrier and here lands in the eventuality slot as a bare kind symbol; the span sense of 'throughout' versus the containment sense of During is likewise not distinguished
notes: The intransitive subject role is the one open call: with a quantity-denoting subject, 'thins' could ride Scalar change (subject -> Theme, as in 'the temperature fell' -> (Theme sk_fall_1 sk_temperature_1)) rather than the internal-change-of-state Patient chosen here, but 'thin' sits closest to the listed weaken/fade, so I did not score it a defect. Genus/modifier decomposition, the definite-singular witness and the absent status atom for the habitual simple present are all correct; exposing 'deep' as a modifier genus is licensed by the part-of-speech line even though 'the winter is deep' is a marginal predication.
